CONFIDENTIAL.

COPY OF POLICE REPORT
dated July 13, 1933.

INFORMATION RE: DIAMOND SMUGGLING.

Further to report submitted on the 7-7-33.
Informant was unable to discover the person who
transported, from Hongkong, the diamonds formerly carried
on the SSS. Chenonceaux, until too late.
A lady now staying with A. Codsi, is said to have performed
the task.
A. Codsi is believed to be an Assyrian, and resides at
No.1A Bearn Apartments, 100 Rue Marcel Tillot, Tel. No.
85052.
The next of his correspondents to arrive in Shanghai
is said to be one of the personnel of the S.S. Andre Lebon?,
named Gillette, rank unknown.
This ship is not expected for a few weeks.

Certified true copy of Police Report
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER : JUL 14 1933 (CRIME BRANCH)）

机密。

警务报告副本
日期：1933年7月13日。

关于：钻石走私的情报。

继1933年7月7日提交的报告之后。
线人未能及时查明此前由“谢农索”号轮船（S.S. Chenonceaux）从香港运送钻石的人员身份。
据称，目前与 A. Codsi 同住的一位女士执行了此项任务。
A. Codsi 据信为亚述人，居住于马塞尔·蒂洛路（Rue Marcel Tillot）100号贝恩公寓（Bearn Apartments）1A室，电话：85052。
据称，其下一位抵达上海的联系人是“安德烈·勒邦”号轮船（S.S. Andre Lebon?）上的一名船员，名为 Gillette，职级不详。
该船预计数周后方能抵达。

经核证无误之警务报告副本
（印：副总监：1933年7月14日（刑事科））

page_data.en:
CONFIDENTIAL.

COPY OF POLICE REPORT
dated July 7, 1933.

INFORMATION RE: DIAMOND SMUGGLING.

On the 6-7-33, the undersigned received confidential in-
formation to the effect that a parcel of diamonds valued
at over $100,000.00 was to be smuggled into Shanghai by
the Purser and/or Chief Steward, of the Messageries Mari-
times S.S. Chenonceaux, due on the 7-7-33.
The gems are said to be intended for one .. Codsi, who
carries on a business under that name at No. 5 Foochow
Road, and resides on Avenue Joffre; it is believed in the
Bearn Apartments.
The abovementioned ship's officers are said to visit Codsi
regularly when in Shanghai for the purpose of delivering
gems.
After communicating with D.D.O. "B", I passed the above
information to the Customs Chief Tide Surveyor.
Subsequently he informed me that for some reason unknown,
the Chenonceaux proceeded no further than Hongkong this
trip, the passengers arriving today at Woosung on another
vessel.
He requested further information when available, as he
finds great difficulty in checking this class of smugg-
ling.
My informant when subsequently communicated with, states
that owing to the non arrival of the Chenonceaux, the
stones were left in a Bank at Hongkong, to be brought to
Shanghai probably next week.
Further information will be communicated to the Chief
Tide Surveyor when available..

Certified true copy
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / JOE 8 1933 / CRIME BRANCH）

机密。

警务报告副本
日期：1933年7月7日。

关于：钻石走私的情报。

1933年7月6日，签署人收到机密情报，称有一批价值超过100,000.00美元的钻石将由法国邮船公司（Messageries Maritimes）“谢农索”号轮船（S.S. Chenonceaux）的大副和/或首席服务员走私进入上海，该船定于1933年7月7日抵达。
据称，这些宝石是交给一位 .. Codsi 先生的，该人以该名义在福州路5号经营生意，居住在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）；据信住在贝恩公寓（Bearn Apartments）。
据称，上述船只的高级船员在上海期间会定期拜访 Codsi 以交付宝石。
在与“B”分区副巡官（D.D.O. "B"）沟通后，我将上述情报转告了海关首席验货员。
随后他通知我，由于某种未知原因，“谢农索”号本轮次仅航行至香港，乘客今日乘坐另一艘船只抵达吴淞。
他表示，鉴于查处此类走私困难重重，如有进一步情报请随时告知。
随后我与线人联系，线人称由于“谢农索”号未抵达，钻石被留在香港的一家银行，可能于下周运至上海。
一旦有进一步情报，将立即通报首席验货员。

经核证无误之副本
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1933年7月8日 / 刑事科）
